notes: *"Stock prices are actually a top down and bottoms up analysis activity… having insight into how the market is actually justifying a current price and deriving what assumptions come along with that provides us with a list of dependencies."* Every pricing surface OTS has shipped so far asks one question: what is this name worth if our assumptions hold. This is the other question — what must be believed for today's price to be fair — and it is deliberately not answered with one inverted number. One price is one equation and the assumptions are many, so infinitely many belief vectors reproduce it
